revised_claim_text: Global cargo tracking hardware installed base: 13.8M active units (end 2024); 26.9M projected by 2029; 14.3% CAGR — Berg Insight, Trailer and Cargo Container Tracking, 13th Edition (December 2025). Trailer tracking accounts for 43% of installed base; intermodal container tracking 41%. Total market revenue €2.7B in 2024, forecast €4.5B by 2029 (10.8% CAGR). ORBCOMM is the largest single provider at 2.1M units (end 2024).
